gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (modified accrual) Total revenues 1,380,647. The Street, Sales Tax and Debt Service schedules (pp12-14) are 'Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis'. Interest income differs by basis: Street Fund p5 47,582 vs p12 cash-basis actual 39,438 (diff 8,144); Sales Tax Fund p5 15,993 vs p13 12,636 (diff 3,357). 8,144 + 3,357 = 11,501 = gap. All other revenue rows (General Fund departments pp16-17, nonmajor combining p15) agree with p5.

Statement p5 Total expenditures 1,214,109. Cash-basis budget schedules: Street Fund p12 'Street operations and maintenance' 128,294 vs p5 Street Fund Public works 128,974 (schedule short 680); Debt Service Fund p14 'Interest expense' 5,798 vs p5 Debt Service interest on long-term debt 5,558 (schedule above by 240). 680 - 240 = 440 = gap. Other funds agree with p5.

Statement p5 Total Governmental Funds column nets transfers: (14,792) out, which is only the transfer to the proprietary funds (4,881 Electric + 9,467 Water + 444 Natural Gas). Detail records transfers gross per fund and per General Fund department as printed: Street (21,945) p12, Sales Tax (115,018) p13 (both to the Debt Service Fund, which receives 136,963 p14), General Fund Airport department (14,792) p17, and the General Fund 'General' department (467,169) p16, which is an intra-General-Fund transfer to the other departments (Police 83,440 + Fire 4,689 + Park 112,101 + Pool 84,864 + Library 127,112 + Cemetery 43,445 + Viking Center 8,483 + Compost Site 3,035 = 467,169, recorded as transfers in). 21,945 + 115,018 + 14,792 + 467,169 = 618,924 = schedule total; 618,924 - 14,792 = 604,132 = gap. All amounts are as printed; the difference is the statement's netting of interfund/interdepartmental transfers.
